description: I don’t waste my time ; I see life for what it is , not what I wish it to be #selflove #intentionalliving #selfmastery
transcript: I take my time, but I do not waste my time and there's a big difference. I take my time by allowing things to evolve and seeing them for what they are and allowing them to meet me where I am, but I don't waste my time. As soon as I hear the alarms going off, as soon as the whistles start blowing, I know that it is time to move. I do not create an alternate reality by creating a moment into something that I think it should be and moving away from what it truly is. I see things for what they are and I allow them to be.
